note: Routes are selected by the server from data: a route is eligible only when every required star has a valid pending-or-approved geometric direction that is not below the geometric horizon. Priority encodes the owner's route preference (2D.1C D-2); no pattern is hard-coded as the entry point.

routes.title: From al-Kaff al-Khaḍīb to al-Jady to True North

steps.prompt: Find al-Kaff al-Khaḍīb, the henna-dyed hand: five bright stars in a zigzag like a W, in the northern sky. Select one of its stars.
steps.successFeedback: That star belongs to al-Kaff al-Khaḍīb. The hand is now outlined.
steps.retryFeedback: That star is not part of the hand. Look for five bright stars in a W shape.

steps.prompt: Follow the guide line from the middle of the hand towards the horizon and select al-Jady.
steps.successFeedback: That is al-Jady, the polar star.
steps.retryFeedback: That is not al-Jady. Follow the guide line all the way to the star low above the northern horizon.

steps.prompt: Now face True North: turn until the centre marker sits on the horizon directly below al-Jady, then confirm your direction.
steps.successFeedback: Your direction has been recorded and compared with True North.
steps.retryFeedback: Your direction has been recorded and compared with True North.

routes.title: From Banāt Naʿsh to al-Jady to True North

steps.prompt: Find Banāt Naʿsh al-Kubrā: seven bright stars, four in a box and three trailing away, in the northern sky. Select one of its stars.
steps.successFeedback: That star belongs to Banāt Naʿsh. The group is now outlined.
steps.retryFeedback: That star is not part of Banāt Naʿsh. Look for a box of four stars with a curved tail of three.

steps.prompt: Follow the guide line through the two end stars of the box and select al-Jady.
steps.successFeedback: That is al-Jady, the polar star.
steps.retryFeedback: That is not al-Jady. Follow the guide line all the way to the star low above the northern horizon.

steps.prompt: Now face True North: turn until the centre marker sits on the horizon directly below al-Jady, then confirm your direction.
steps.successFeedback: Your direction has been recorded and compared with True North.
steps.retryFeedback: Your direction has been recorded and compared with True North.
